Within this overarching holding structure, Vcom operates as a critical subsidiary of Veramani IT Holding Company. The operational model of Vcom is specifically defined as an Aerial Fibre Network Operator (FNO). Unlike traditional subterranean network deployments, the aerial fibre model leverages existing above-ground infrastructure, such as utility poles, to suspend fibre optic cables. The deployment of aerial networks is increasingly recognized as a strategic imperative to capture market share in areas where subterranean deployment is either economically prohibitive or logistically unfeasible.
